layoutB.note: Option (b), release note 9: lid off, v5 stack standing on stack_bridge over the cells. BUILDABLE layout. Positions ON THE CAR (parts.json draws this group shifted +130 mm in X). Order: bridge, carrier deck (carrier), tier 1 PCA9685, tier 2 ESP32, cap. Extra tiers add 26 mm each in Z.
